Mukudzeishe Primrose Tarugarira

Impact Leader

Mukudzeishe Primrose Tarugarira (Impact Leader) is part of the leadership team of Young AI Leaders Gweru Hub, a youth-led artificial intelligence and technology community in Gweru, Midlands Province, Zimbabwe, and part of the Young AI Leaders Community under ITU's AI for Good.

Leads impact and community outcomes for the hub, tracking how projects translate into real, measurable change across Gweru. Also doubles as our social media manager.
